projects.title: Performance Optimization – Practical Lab #1
projects.description: Comprehensive industrial coding exercise #1 covering Performance Optimization, runtime performance, API contracts, and edge cases.
projects.learningOutcome: Mastering core engineering principles, ECMAScript specs, and V8 optimization rules for Performance Optimization.
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **ECMAScript Specification & Engine Invariants**:
Detailed technical breakdown of underlying C++/V8 compiler pipelines, memory allocation models, and runtime algorithms for Performance Optimization.

2. **Algorithmic Reasoning & Mental Model**:
Step-by-step logic strategy and control flow execution.

3. **Production Edge Cases & Defenses**:
Handling memory leaks, asynchronous race conditions, and browser cross-compatibility hazards.
projects.codeExplanation: The script implements a robust solution for Performance Optimization Lab #1, verifying inputs, executing logic, and logging diagnostic output.
